digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Verified dispatch workflow
propositions: Gerrit Verified dispatch-triggered runs, not tickets-branch pushes, dominated the 2026-08-12/13 Actions pool saturation; the tickets branch has no workflows and produced zero runs.

Incident-period peak (2026-08-13 20:30Z) reached 22 waiting jobs and 873s maximum runner wait across seven dispatches in five minutes; current-shape peak (2026-08-15 17:30Z) reached 22 waiting jobs with 197s maximum wait across three independent runs.

The full Verified route with mutation shards executes up to 24 runner jobs per patchset, with immediate fan-out of 13 jobs after classification and a single shared macOS job per run lasting 20–25 minutes.

Four mutually exclusive policy options exist: bundle four Ubuntu preflights and cap mutation parallelism (Option A, recommended), coalesce superseded patchsets before dispatch (Option B, low marginal value), move macOS to scheduled branch health (Option C, weakens pre-merge coverage), or upgrade the organization plan to Team (Option D, recurring cost).
No CI behavior was changed and no remediation was selected; the ticket remains open for operator approval of the chosen policy direction before implementation.
